meta.name: baoyu-post-to-weibo
meta.description: Posts content to Weibo (微博). Supports regular posts with text, images, and videos, and headline articles (头条文章) with Markdown input via Chrome CDP. Use when user asks to "post to Weibo", "发微博", "发布微博", "publish to Weibo", "share on Weibo", "写微博", or "微博头条文章".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动将内容发布到微博
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定时或批量发布微博内容
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to schedule or batch post to Weibo

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你把文字、图片、视频或 Markdown 文章发布到微博。它会自动打开浏览器填好内容，你只需手动点发布。
howto.when: 当你要求“发微博”、“发布微博”、“写微博”或“微博头条文章”时触发。

say.text: 帮我发一条微博：今天天气真好！
say.note: Claude 会打开浏览器并填好文字。

say.text: 把这篇 Markdown 文章发成微博头条文章。
say.note: Claude 会打开头条文章编辑器并填入内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can post text, images, videos, or Markdown articles to Weibo. It opens a browser, fills in the content, and you manually publish.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "post to Weibo", "发微博", "发布微博", "publish to Weibo", "share on Weibo", "写微博", or "微博头条文章".

say_en.text: Post a Weibo: The weather is great today!
say_en.note: Claude opens browser and fills text.

say_en.text: Publish this Markdown file as a headline article on Weibo.
say_en.note: Claude opens the article editor and fills content.
